prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Produce one polished ORIGINAL Chinese technical textbook illustration for an embodied-AI foundations article. Landscape 1536x1024, light paper background #f6f6f5, cobalt blue #0837a5 and ink #171415, a very small amount of neutral gray. Flat precise technical line illustration with clear schematic robotic arms and grippers, readable Chinese sans-serif labels, generous spacing, large lettering (readable when image is shown at 780 pixels wide). No brand, watermark, title banner, gradients, pictorial human brains, decorative circuits or tiny paragraphs. Content accuracy and straightforward reading order matter.
Draw a closed loop explaining grasping a cup. Four clearly separated scenes in a clockwise 2x2 arrangement: top-left 感知, top-right 判断, bottom-right 行动, bottom-left 反馈. Clockwise arrows connect them, including a large return arrow from feedback to perception. Each scene depicts the SAME tabletop, a simple ceramic cup with handle, compact 6-axis robot arm with parallel jaw gripper, and external camera. 感知: camera sees cup and arm; label 读取图像与关节状态. 判断: cup position and grasp target shown as small cobalt pose axes and gripper goal outline; label 估计位置，选择动作. 行动: robot gripper approaches and grasps cup, with clear short movement arrow; label 执行抓取. 反馈: lifted cup is slightly tilted and slipping downward in the gripper; subtle slip arrow, camera/force feedback directs next adjustment; label 观察变化，调整动作. The feedback arrow must return to 感知. Illustrative conceptual physical scenes, not literal hardware measurements. Clear succinct accurate Chinese text only. Avoid implying that feedback is a completed final step rather than continuing the loop.
